explanation: Starting from x=0.5, v=0.5 with light cart (0.5kg), heavy long pole (0.2kg, 1m) and high gravity (12), the state-feedback controller applied only ~0.5N corrective force, prioritizing pole angle (theta ~0.067 rad, well within limits) over cart position. The cart drifted monotonically outward at ~1.3 m/s until it left the +/-2.4m track at step 95.
